cross_references.relationship: frequently pleaded together -- 526a provides taxpayer standing to challenge illegal expenditures; 1085 mandamus compels the officer to perform a duty. When a government officer both spends illegally and refuses to perform a legal duty, both statutes apply.
fee-shifting companion -- a taxpayer who successfully enjoins illegal spending under 526a may recover attorney's fees under 1021.5 if the action conferred a significant public benefit

Tort Claims Act boundary -- 526a is an equitable action (injunction), not a tort claim, so the Government Claims Act (Gov. Code 810+) does not require a prior claim filing; but the two frameworks define different aspects of government accountability litigation
